The Authentic Name

Why tajikarao.com is the correct form

Japanese characters

手力男神

The name in its original Japanese characters form. 手力男神 carries the full phonetic and orthographic weight of the source tradition.

ASCII Constraint

TAJIKARAO

Stripped of its identity, the name was reduced to plain Latin letters. The original orthography — stress, length, breathing — was erased by systems that only understand A-Z.

Unicode Restoration

Tajikarao

The Unicode restoration recovers what ASCII destroyed. This is philological accuracy — not decoration. The domain encodes to Punycode, but the browser displays the truth.

Punycode Encoding
tajikarao.com → tajikarao.com

The non-ASCII characters in Tajikarao are encoded while the ASCII remains visible. To the DNS, it is Punycode. To humanity, it is Tajikarao.

Tier Classification

Why Tajikarao is classified as Tier-2 Basic

The Japanese form 手力男神 preserves neither stress nor length in this Unicode restoration. This makes it a single-tier Tier-2 Basic name — still a scholarly step above plain ASCII, but without the distinctive phonetic features that define higher tiers.
